_README: Results already measured by the pipeline, transcribed here so the manuscript can
report real numbers before every module has been re-run on this machine.
make_tables.py prefers the live JSON written by each module on Drive. This file is
used ONLY for quantities whose live file is absent, and any table built from it is
captioned as transcribed rather than read from a result file.
Every entry carries a 'source' naming the run it came from. Entries marked
'read_from_figure': true were read off a plot axis and are therefore approximate to
the stated precision; the exact values live in module6_metrics.json and will replace
these automatically once Module 6 is re-run with the current code.
DELETE AN ENTRY rather than editing it if you doubt it: a missing number prints as
[pending], which is honest, whereas a wrong number is not.

reconstruction.note: Single video. The multi-video means will replace this once multi_video_summary.json is present.

training.source: Module 5, 500-epoch run, checkpoint selected at best validation

comparison.source: Module 6 QT1, checkpoint epoch 60, full held-out set, 10 videos
comparison.note: Three methods only. The full eleven-method table requires Module 7.

direction.source: Module 6 visual inference, rollout from frame 175, workspace_v2
